Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to verify the credibility of the initial search results before issuing further instructions. In Step 1, the Planner accepted the Wikipedia snippet stating KGOT is in the "Dimond Center" as a confirmed fact without checking the official KGOT website or FCC filings for the specific address details visible in the search results (which listed "800 E. Dimond Blvd #3-370"). This premature acceptance of unverified data from a secondary source (Wikipedia) led to a subsequent error where the Planner repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to search for "Dimond Center square footage" despite the search results already containing the answer (728,000 sq ft) in the visible viewport. The Planner's instructions became redundant and failed to adapt to the fact that the information was already present, creating a loop of unnecessary searches.
